scope: Complete standalone generic Boolean solves on generated public systems. No curve inputs, imported targets, scalar/key recovery, production solver changes, index-calculus or rho campaigns. This driver is not the repository inherited-F4 solver.
fixtures: n+2 equations, twelve distinct quadratic monomials and up to four linear monomials per equation. Planted families choose constants to satisfy a public reproducible Boolean witness that is never passed to the solver. Cross-planted makes a pair differ by a valid affine consequence. Unplanted constants are independent; its status is established by complete search when available. No fixture screening.
solver: Exact Boolean specialization with parity cancellation; zero/constant checks; canonical affine reduction and forced assignments; degree-3 linear-tail calls for kernel arms; most-frequent-variable branching with low-index ties, zero branch first. Complete affine residuals are solved directly. Search-only uses identical non-kernel operations. Every solve has fresh solve-lifetime caches and a deterministic node budget.

controls.search: Complete search with exact specialization and cheap affine propagation, without a Macaulay kernel. Also supplies the independent status reference when it completes.
controls.flat: Same search, with retained cached flat linear-tail strategy.
controls.bucket: Same search, with retained sparse-bucket tail strategy.
controls.hybrid: Same search, with the measured fixed 512-column dispatcher and exact-bitmap streamed kernel.
controls.small_flat: Call the existing flat degree-2 tail only when at most ten variables remain active; otherwise continue exact search. This is the same inference policy as word_tail.
controls.word_tail: The same selective degree-2 policy, with compressed active-variable coordinates. Its entire possible degree<=2 space has at most 56 columns and fits in one u64. Generate and eliminate complete degree-2 rows directly in that word; return the identical canonical affine tail.
controls.merge_search: Identical search-only algorithm, but specialize zero assignments by in-place filtering and one true variable by an order-preserving symmetric-difference merge. Multiple true assignments retain the canonical sorting fallback. Generator order and deduplication are unchanged.
controls.quadratic_state: Same complete search policy as merge_search. Compile immutable quadratic neighbor masks once per cold solve, then retain active variables, live equations, linear masks, constants and exact quadratic edge counts. Assignments update coefficients by XOR, detect all degree drops and remove exact duplicate equations in original order. Non-quadratic inputs fall back to merge_search; every fixture in this protocol has degree at most two.
controls.packed_state: One u64 coefficient word per residual equation: local ordered quadratic positions followed by common linear-variable coordinates and a constant. At most 32 original quadratic terms and q+n<64 are required; otherwise use the retained quadratic-state implementation. Fixed touch masks implement assignments, a stack pivot basis replaces affine allocations, and exact equality checks hash-bucket candidates for deduplication. Every benchmark fixture fits without fallback.
controls.basis_list: Transport a coefficient-row-space basis of quadratic polynomials through assignments. Recompute canonical full RREF with sorted polynomial-list symmetric differences; use all affine consequences, then branch by term frequencies in the reduced basis.
controls.basis_wide: Identical full-RREF inference and branching policy to basis_list, using at most eleven u64 words per row and global degree<=2 coordinates. No Macaulay multiplication rows.
controls.tail_list: Transport a quadratic echelon basis and canonically reduce its affine tail. Keep a separately charged packed copy of original residual equations for the legacy frequency branching heuristic. Sorted polynomial-list elimination supplies an exact policy reference.
controls.tail_wide: Same inference, source-equation branching, outcomes/models, logical counters and trace as tail_list. Use packed global coefficient rows for basis transport. The extra original-equation state and all its updates are charged.
controls.packed_untraced: Accounting control: unchanged packed search decisions, models and logical counters, with diagnostic hashing removed. Trace is null. It is included in the speed reference so omitted tree-hashing work cannot manufacture a candidate gain.
controls.affine_sl_basis_list: Exact general affine substitution and original-variable recovery, with degree-preserving Boolean variable products when at most ten free coordinates remain; branch using the retained quadratic-echelon basis. Direct polynomial-list reference.
controls.affine_sl_basis_fast: Same policy, model, counters and trace as affine_sl_basis_list. Compact free coordinates, one-word coefficient rows at width<=10, exact point-operator caches and direct whole-word affine-product images. Every setup/update/recovery cost is charged.
controls.gray_scalar: Compile up to 32 equation values into a u32 syndrome; enumerate high variables by finite differences in Gray order and all sixteen low-variable assignments per block. Scalar reference, with full assignment/block accounting and a block checksum.
controls.gray_simd: Same exhaustive ordering, models, point counts and checksum as gray_scalar, using NEON on AArch64 and SSE2 on x86_64, with scalar fallback elsewhere. All possible assignments are covered for UNSAT; no search-tree node count is implied.
controls.packed_gray12_scalar: Retained packed search and cheap affine propagation, switching to exact scalar syndrome enumeration when at most twelve occurring variables remain. The zero-leaf-cutoff control preserves the original packed trace.
controls.packed_gray12_simd: Same prefix search, leaf assignments, models, counters and checksum as packed_gray12_scalar, with SIMD evaluation of sixteen points per block.
controls.packed_gray16_scalar: Same hybrid policy with a fixed cutoff of sixteen occurring variables and scalar enumeration.
controls.packed_gray16_simd: Same prefix/leaf policy as packed_gray16_scalar, using SIMD evaluation.

correctness: Verify every SAT assignment independently against original equations. An UNSAT output counts as independently verified only when complete search-only also returns UNSAT. Kernel arms must match outcome/model, every logical search counter and a stable trace digest. The digest is a reproducibility diagnostic, not a collision-resistant proof. Exhaustive small-system tests compare all arms with full Boolean enumeration. Node/kernel caps return UNKNOWN, never UNSAT. Small-flat and word-tail policies must match outcomes/models, all logical counters and trace digests. Word-kernel tails/source dimensions are cross-checked against the existing degree-2 flat kernel on embedded variable sets. All solver modes join exhaustive small-system tests. Exhaustively compare ordered specialization with the sorting reference for all 256 small Boolean polynomials and all 27 partial assignments, including duplicated equations and constant cancellation. Confirm complete search trace equality on larger seeded cases. The quadratic state must materialize identical residual equations for all 128 degree-at-most-two polynomials on three variables, every partial assignment and a second assignment; tests include duplicates, zero equations and coefficient cancellation. Search, merge_search and quadratic_state must match exact logical counters, outcomes/models and streamed canonical trace digests on every benchmark cell. Packed-state outcomes/models, all logical counters and trace digests must match all three retained search-only arms. Exhaustive tests compare every 3-variable affine row space in both insertion orders; local-coordinate residuals under every first and second partial assignment; and fallback at the 64-bit coordinate limit. Hash buckets only shortlist candidates: accepted equality is exact. Each new list/packed pair must match all logical counters, models and trace digests. Exhaustively verify 442368 three-variable row-span/assignment cases, including equality with rebuilding after specialization; independently check solution sets. Dense tests cover global coordinate word boundaries through n36 and repeated assignments. Canonical full RREF and quadratic-echelon/affine-tail policies are distinct groups. New affine maps are checked against all 524288 quadratic-polynomial/affine-map combinations on three variables, an independent truth-table/Mobius oracle, 331776 recovery compositions, and all 5592404 one-word affine-product pairs through ten variables. Scalar/packed multiplication policies agree and preserve small solution sets. Every Gray block through n12 is checked against direct evaluation, including all 32 syndrome bits; SIMD zero detection and wrapping checksums are tested for every forced lane. Hybrids with a disabled leaf match packed_state exactly. The untraced packed control matches its models and logical counters. Unsupported degree/row domains use the retained fallback; every benchmark fixture lies inside all selected domains.
accounting: Cold total includes solver/context construction, coefficient/coordinate compilation, all substitution and product work, every recursive node or enumerated assignment, checksums, original-model recovery, context destruction and independent result validation. Encoding of enumeration leaves is included. Fixture generation, the completed status reference and JSON formatting are outside arm timers and inside process receipts. All twenty-two arm positions occur once in twenty-two rotated repetitions. kernel_ns, substitution_ns and enumeration_ns are disjoint measured subsets. Uninstrumented phase costs are null. Enumeration arms report points, blocks and leaf calls; zero search nodes is not zero work. Added degree-two product rows and all resulting reductions are counted. Caches are new for each solve, and their construction/destruction is charged.
performance_gate: For each of search,bucket,hybrid against flat separately, require every n=16/20/24 and every family holdout cell to have a 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0. Also test hybrid against the pointwise fastest of all three controls. All arms on the full grid must complete with verified results before any unqualified full-solve promotion. Missing/censored cells retain null completion costs and block promotion.
memory: Whole-worker RSS includes all arms and reference preparation. All contexts are cold per solve. Original limits remain; compact affine layouts retain at most 128 entries, and point plans at most 256 entries. Derived degree-two inference is restricted to at most ten remaining variables and rank at most 56. Syndrome enumeration is bounded to 24 variables and 32 equations; the whole-vector form stores O(n^2) u32 coefficients. Leaf cutoffs 12 and 16 are fixed. Candidate-specific peak allocation is not measured.
classification: Complete bounded generic Boolean-search diagnostic, not a production inherited-solver benchmark or a cryptanalytic result. Index-calculus cost and rho ratios remain null.
word_gate: On every family at n=16/20/24, require the 95 percent paired lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest of all four prior whole-solve methods and above 1.05 against the same-policy small_flat control. All 18 comparisons and all grid completions/verification must pass. Gates against flat are also retained, without dropping any failures.
predecessor: PR 671 row-space transport is retained. All 96 previously timed systems are reused, and 24 fresh systems are added. Seven discovery-only prototypes and a native SAT feasibility check led to the frozen finalists. Unselected prototypes remain archived; no speed claim is based on them.
merge_gate: On every family at n=16/20/24, require the 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest of all six prior complete-solve methods. Require all grid completions and independent verification. Search and merge_search must have identical outcomes/models, logical counters and trace digests.
quadratic_gate: On every family at n=16/20/24, require the 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest of all seven prior complete-solve methods. All nine comparisons and every grid completion/verification must pass. All search-only arms must have identical outcomes/models, logical counters and trace digests. Any missing/censored result blocks promotion. No parameter tuning after holdout measurements.
packed_gate: Require a 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 versus the pointwise fastest of all eight retained complete-solve methods, including quadratic_state, on every n=16/20/24 and family in BOTH regression and fresh-holdout splits. All 18 comparisons and all 72 grid completions must pass. A separate >1.0 lower-bound gate reports incremental improvement without calling it dramatic. Retain a separate cumulative >2.0 comparison versus the historical seven methods; it cannot replace the current-frontier gate. No tuning after holdout measurements.
resource_probes: resource_probe_01 through 05 retain the affine, compact, product, direct-image and basis-branching discoveries; 06 and 07 retain direct Gray and hybrid-leaf comparisons. All use only n24 seed17 and three families, one repetition. native_resource_probe_01 uses a Python binding to installed CryptoMiniSat on the same public fixtures; it is a separate-process feasibility check, not a same-binary comparison. No holdouts were used for these choices.
basis_gate: For basis_wide and tail_wide separately, require a 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest of ALL twelve other arms at every n16/20/24 and family in BOTH regression and fresh-holdout splits. All 18 comparisons and all 96 grid completions/verification must pass. Also report an incremental lower-bound >1.0 gate against the same strongest reference and a separate >1.05 same-policy backend gate. Backend gains do not substitute for complete-method gains. No tuning after holdout measurement.
final_gate: Before any holdout timing, fix this reference roster: all thirteen previously retained methods, packed_untraced, the affine finalist pair and all three scalar enumeration controls. For each SIMD candidate separately require every n16/20/24 and family in BOTH regression and holdout splits to have a 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest reference. The affine finalist uses the same roster with itself removed. All eighteen comparisons and all 120 grid completions/verification must pass. A separate same-policy backend threshold is 1.05. Comparisons among the three new SIMD treatments are selection diagnostics and do not redefine the preregistered reference. No parameter changes after holdout measurement; any selected passing treatment requires an unchanged-source confirmation on new holdout seeds before a robust claim.
checksum_contract: Gray checksums fold each high Gray-step index and the u32 wrapping sum of all sixteen equation-syndrome values into FNV; n<4 checks individual syndromes. They are diagnostics, not cryptographic certificates or tree traces. Scalar/SIMD pairs must match models, logical counts and checksums. Hybrids retain canonical packed-prefix traces and append leaf checksums. The packed_untraced trace is null and cannot be used as trace-equivalence evidence.
confirmation_plan: Declared while the primary timing run is still active. Use unchanged worker and acceptance thresholds; replay the two primary holdout seeds as regression inputs and add two unused holdout seeds. A treatment must pass BOTH the full primary grid and this confirmation. Earlier failed cells and candidates remain retained; this run cannot supersede a primary rejection.
